notes.title: Bug Fixes and first Levels approved for Level Editor
notes.notes:
Hello!

I fixed a few more Bugs and also approved the first 6 Levels for the Level Editor. I also improved the Level Editor a LOT! Its my dream feature to have a Level Editor and play your Levels so I will work a lot on the Level Editor in the Future. Here is what changed:

-> You can now play the first 6 Levels by worldwide Users on the "Level Server" Tab in the Level Editor
-> You can now add a tag to your Level when you save it (Tags like Dungeon, Platforming, Puzzle, Auto Runner etc.)
-> You can now rank the difficulty of your Level that other Players can choose if they want hard or easy Levels
-> A lot of Quality of Life Improvements. Just try it out and have fun ^^

Any more wishes? Im more than happy to add all your ideas! Also please only use English Language on Texts in your Levels since the Levels are international and I saw a lot of German-Only Levels.

Best regards,
Mateo

notes.title: Big News & Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Im SUPER excited to announce that Makis Adventure will launch on Consoles THIS YEAR!!! This was my big dream as a gamedeveloper ever since the game launched... More information will be shared soon. Together with eastasiasoft, we will bring Maki into new oceans to swim in :)

This Update changed a lot of backend stuff that you wont see directly: I switched to Unity 6 which was recommended and I had to fix a lot of bugs that came up after the Upgrade, but Im happy to finally say that all problems were solved and the game will run smoother and more bug-free now. I rewrote and improved a LOT of the game-code and also switched to JSON files for the Save-Files. That means that you can now see all the clear values and look through the save-files now easier ^^

That sadly also means that the earlier save-files might not work anymore, but they wont be deleted, so you will still have them on your PC!

Have a great day!

Best regards,
Mateo (ZoroArts)

notes.title: Big Content Update
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to the biggest Makis Adventure Update yet!

I spent the last months working on this Update every single day and I hope that you will like the changes.

Here are the News:

-> The 3D Hubworld has Textures now and I tried to improve the overall look.

-> A new minigame: Waterball can be found on the Hubworld

-> I added my dream feature: A Level Editor to the game! Im a big fan of Mario Maker and developing a Level Editor was my big goal and dream for Makis Adventure. I spent 5 months building this feature and you can build levels and dungeons with all the elements from the main-game. I even added extra objects such as snow, ice, canons, chainsaws and other elements for you to make cool levels.

-> I remade and improved a LOT of the UIs in the game

-> More Settings are now accessible for you

-> There were some problems with the Steam-Achievements, which should be fixed now

-> I rewrote the whole Save-System and I now use JSON files. Your previous save-data will not be deleted but sadly I have to admit that it is not working anymore for the new Update. Im sorry for that!

-> Auto-Scrolling on UI is now possible. If you hold the joystick in a specific direction now, it keeps scrolling.

-> You can now see the needed score to get gold, silver or bronce in the Minigame Tutorial UI.

-> I added a black outline to all the characters, enemies and interactible objects to make them stand out.

-> A LOT of Bugs were fixed and some smaller changes were made

I hope that you will enjoy the new changes and wish you a fantastic day!

notes.title: BIG Patch with dozens of improvements
notes.notes:
I worked super hard on the new Patch and would love to get your feedback! Tried to watch every stream and video to collect your feedback! Please share some more feedback and impressions in the Discussion forum :)

[u][b]A list of the changes:[/b][/u]

-Multiplayer Mode improved

-3D Area texturized and improved

-Mulitple Bugs were fixed

-Speedrun mode implemented (Ingame Timer and all Cutscenes are skipped)

-Camera and 3D Turn sensitivity implemented

-3D Camera Y-Axis can be inverted now

-White Player-Outline can be deactivated

-Bossfights were nerfed and balanced

-Makis Scythe-Hitbox was decreased a bit

-Maki Coins now also in the 3D Area

-Cancel option in minigame tutorial

-New Ingame Music

-Minecart Collision Area increased

-Missing Lava Hitbox in Vulcano Dungeon implemented

-Game Window now resizeable

-The stamina bar is now on top of Maki

-Scythe Throw uses stamina now

-Scythe Throw "Out of Bounds" Bug fixed

-The waterball minigame was temporarily deactivated due to some major bugs (will be activated with the next Update coming this month)
